pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. One complete white window frame with two open blue shutters. Inside view bright LIGHT BLUE DAYTIME sky, high yellow sun, two small white clouds, low green hill. Small potted plant on sill. Pure white outside window, flat solid fills dark outlines, no text or people. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
